build_facial_stream: build a facial attributes analysis stream using ResNet18 with configurable pooling and fully connected layers
build_lipreading_stream: build a lipreading network stream with TCN options and configurable backbone from a JSON config file
build_audio_stream: build an audio stream UNet model with configurable feature dimensions and weight initialization
build_vocal_stream: build a vocal attributes analysis stream using ResNet18 with single-channel input and configurable output
build_av_models: build all audio-visual enhancement models using the ModelBuilder class for facial, lipreading, audio, and vocal streams
